BillHeading.BriefDescription: Recognizing judicially affirmed and treaty-reserved fishing rights and promoting state-tribal cooperative agreements in the management of salmon, trout, and steelhead resources.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to recognizing judicially affirmed and treaty-reserved fishing rights and promoting state-tribal cooperative agreements in the management of salmon, trout, and steelhead resources; creating a new section; and repealing RCW 77.110.010, 77.110.020, 77.110.030, 77.110.040, and 77.110.900.

BillSectionHeader.P: The legislature finds that chapter 77.110 RCW is inconsistent with judicially affirmed and treaty-reserved fishing rights. The legislature also finds that chapter 77.110 RCW conflicts with well-established state-tribal cooperative fishery management agreements. Therefore, the legislature acknowledges that in order to keep its commitments and relationship with Pacific Northwest tribes and to avoid any legal confusion with current cooperative agreements, it is necessary to repeal chapter 77.110 RCW.
The following acts or parts of acts are each repealed:

BillSection.P: 3RCW 77.110.030 (Management of natural resources—State policy) and 1985 c 1 s 3;
4RCW 77.110.040 (Declaration—Denial of rights based on race, sex, origin, or cultural heritage) and 1985 c 1 s 4; and
5RCW 77.110.900 (Transmittal of act to president and congress—1985 c 1) and 1985 c 1 s 5.
